This documentation-only change records the owner's existing REL-HR wording decisions, including the leave-defaults label, and the rule that expired free-time offers must be excluded from later waiting counts.

The approved wording remains a future go-live code step. Current screens, historical payslip/export snapshots, permissions, schemas and production data are unchanged. Historical decisions are attributed to the original owner confirmation; this PR grants no new approval or activation.

The normal main refresh preserves both original documentation blobs exactly. Both original blobs remain identical after refreshing main at 141418b06. Diff checks and independent source review pass; fresh exact-head repository CI remains a merge gate. No runtime tests were rerun for this unchanged docs-only scope.
